title: Static Trestle Cabin and Four Lattice Sail Mill
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed timber sail-mill exterior. Two crossed ground shoes and four diagonal braces surround a thick central fixed post supporting a whole raised wooden cabin, real open wall windows and rear entry, full floor and thick gabled cap. A full horizontal windshaft projects from the cabin into a distinct front hub with four long complete lattice sails, each with real empty rung apertures. Behind are one full small entry platform, six fixed treads with complete side stringers and a separate long tail beam ending on a ground foot. Unlike the old small tubular wind-turbine mast with three solid propeller blades or a tapered lighthouse with a lantern gallery, this is a raised post-and-trestle millhouse with an open-grid sail assembly and rear access/tail relation. Every numeric body, aperture and sail frame newly drawn; no old lighthouse, rotor, cabin or stairs mesh imported. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres Z-up and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete static building prop zero scenes. Stylized post-mill-inspired exterior only, no internal milling machinery, exact historic reconstruction, wind capture, rotation, grinding, transmission, human access, structural load, construction or equipment safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
